name: Deck of Cards Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Deck of Cards Mahjong is a puzzle game that mixes elements of poker cards and mahjong puzzles. This online game is set against a sepia-colored background with delightful music. Basically, this online game follows the rules of mahjong but uses poker cards for you to play. Instead of matching mahjong tiles, you are matching cards with the same suit and number. If you think this is a quick game, then think again. There are 120 different levels with different patterns and challenges for you to conquer! Some patterns spell out words and others are just pretty designs. All of them are their own challenge and require their own strategy in this online game. Select the High Scores to see if your score lands you in the top 200 players for this card game. Play again until you make it on the High Scores list!
